1	"""Deterministic PII detectors.
2	
3	These need no model and no network. They cover the identifiers that are
4	convention-bound (emails, phones, URLs, IDs) where regex + validation beats
5	a neural model on precision, and they give the runtime a floor when a model
6	is unavailable. Student names are the hard case and are left to the model
7	layer; the rules only catch names introduced by explicit cues
8	("My name is ...").
9	"""
10	
11	from __future__ import annotations
12	
13	import re
14	from typing import Iterable, List
15	
16	from .types import Entity
17	
18	NAME_LABELS = ["NAME_STUDENT", "NAME_RELATED"]
19	
20	# --- Patterns -------------------------------------------------------------
21	
22	EMAIL_RE = re.compile(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}\b")
23	
24	# US-centric phone patterns; international forms with + prefix.
25	PHONE_RE = re.compile(
26	    r"(?<![\w.])(?:\+?1[\s.-]?)?(?:\(\d{3}\)|\d{3})[\s.-]?\d{3}[\s.-]?\d{4}(?:[ \t]?(?:x|ext\.?)[ \t]?\d{1,6})?(?!\w)(?!\.\d)"
27	    r"|(?<![\w.])\+\d{1,3}[\s.-]?\d{2,4}(?:[\s.-]?\d{2,4}){2,3}(?!\w)(?!\.\d)"
28	)
29	
30	SSN_RE = re.compile(r"(?<!\d)(?!000|666|9\d\d)\d{3}[- ](?!00)\d{2}[- ](?!0000)\d{4}(?!\d)")
31	
32	URL_RE = re.compile(r"\b(?:https?://|www\.)[^\s<>\"']+", re.IGNORECASE)
33	# Bare domains are case-sensitive and need a boundary after the TLD, so a
34	# missing space after a full stop ("5.Approach", "solution.Education") is
35	# not read as a domain.
36	BARE_DOMAIN_RE = re.compile(
37	    r"(?<![\w@./-])(?=[a-z0-9-]*[a-z])[a-z0-9-]{2,}(?:\.[a-z0-9-]+)*\.(?:com|net|org|io|me|edu|co|dev|app|info)(?![A-Za-z0-9-])(?:/[^\s<>\"']*)?"
38	)
39	
40	# Handles and usernames: @handle, "username: xyz", "user: xyz"
41	# Strong cues only ever introduce an account name. Platform cues are also
42	# ordinary words ("handle the issue", "twitter is great"), so after them the
43	# value has to look like a handle or follow an explicit ":" / "=".
44	USERNAME_STRONG_CUES = r"username|user name|user id|userid|screen name|gamertag"
45	USERNAME_PLATFORM_CUES = r"handle|login|discord|instagram|insta|snap|snapchat|tiktok|twitter|github|roblox|xbox|psn"
46	USERNAME_CUES = rf"{USERNAME_STRONG_CUES}|{USERNAME_PLATFORM_CUES}"
47	USERNAME_RE = re.compile(
48	    r"(?<![\w@])@([A-Za-z0-9_.]{3,30})\b"                                                    # @handle
49	    rf"|\b(?:{USERNAME_CUES})(?![./\w])[ \t]*[:=][ \t]*@?([A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9_.]{{2,29}})\b"  # cue: value
50	    rf"|\b(?:{USERNAME_STRONG_CUES})\b[^.\n@]{{0,40}}?\bis[ \t]+@?([A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9_.]{{2,29}})\b"  # strong cue ... is value
51	    rf"|\b(?:{USERNAME_PLATFORM_CUES})(?![./\w])(?:[ \t]+(?:is|-))?[ \t]+@?([A-Za-z]*[0-9_.][A-Za-z0-9_.]*)\b"  # platform cue + handle-like value
52	    rf"|\b(?:{USERNAME_PLATFORM_CUES})\b[^.\n@]{{0,40}}?\bis[ \t]+@?([A-Za-z]*[0-9_][A-Za-z0-9_.]*)\b",          # platform cue ... is handle-like value
53	    re.IGNORECASE,
54	)

201	def _url_is_personal(url: str, before: str = "") -> bool:
202	    """`before` is the text leading up to the URL."""
203	    u = url.lower()
204	    if any(h in u for h in PERSONAL_URL_HINTS):
205	        return True
206	    if any(a in u for a in URL_ALLOWLIST):
207	        return False
208	    # A bare site name ("draw.io", "www.klaxoon.com") is a product or a
209	    # publication unless the writer calls it theirs ("my store is ...").
210	    path = re.sub(r"^(?:https?://)?[^/]+", "", u).strip("/.,;:)]}'\"")
211	    if not path:
212	        return bool(OWN_SITE_CUE_RE.search(before))
213	    # Default: a page on an unknown domain in student writing is treated as personal.
214	    return True

217	def _luhn_ok(digits: str) -> bool:
218	    total, alt = 0, False
219	    for ch in reversed(digits):
220	        d = int(ch)
221	        if alt:
222	            d *= 2
223	            if d > 9:
224	                d -= 9
225	        total += d
226	        alt = not alt
227	    return total % 10 == 0

232	def _add(ents: List[Entity], label: str, m_start: int, m_end: int, text: str, conf: float) -> None:
233	    span = text[m_start:m_end]
234	    # Trim trailing punctuation that regexes sometimes swallow.
235	    while span and span[-1] in ".,;:)]}'\"":
236	        span = span[:-1]
237	        m_end -= 1
238	    if not span.strip():
239	        return
240	    ents.append(Entity(label=label, text=span, start=m_start, end=m_end, confidence=conf, source="rules"))
241

243	def detect_rules(text: str, labels: Iterable[str] | None = None) -> List[Entity]:
244	    """Run every rule detector over `text` and return non-overlapping entities."""
245	    wanted = set(labels) if labels else None
246	    ents: List[Entity] = []
247	
248	    def want(label: str) -> bool:
249	        return wanted is None or label in wanted
250	
251	    if want("EMAIL"):
252	        for m in EMAIL_RE.finditer(text):
253	            _add(ents, "EMAIL", m.start(), m.end(), text, 0.99)
254	
255	    if want("SSN"):
256	        for m in SSN_RE.finditer(text):
257	            _add(ents, "SSN", m.start(), m.end(), text, 0.97)
258	
259	    if want("PHONE_NUM"):
260	        for m in PHONE_RE.finditer(text):
261	            digits = re.sub(r"\D", "", m.group())
262	            if 10 <= len(digits) <= 15:
263	                _add(ents, "PHONE_NUM", m.start(), m.end(), text, 0.95)
264	
265	    if want("URL_PERSONAL"):
266	        for m in list(URL_RE.finditer(text)) + list(BARE_DOMAIN_RE.finditer(text)):
267	            # Domains inside an email address are handled by the EMAIL rule.
268	            if "@" in text[max(0, m.start() - 1):m.start()]:
269	                continue
270	            if _url_is_personal(m.group(), text[max(0, m.start() - 170):m.start()]):
271	                _add(ents, "URL_PERSONAL", m.start(), m.end(), text, 0.9)
272	
273	    if want("USERNAME"):
274	        for m in USERNAME_RE.finditer(text):
275	            g = next((i for i in (1, 2, 3, 4, 5) if m.group(i)), None)
276	            if g is None:
277	                continue
278	            # Skip handles that are actually part of an email.
279	            if EMAIL_RE.search(text[max(0, m.start() - 1):m.end() + 1]):
280	                continue
281	            value = m.group(g).rstrip(".")
282	            if len(value) < 3 or not any(ch.isalpha() for ch in value):
283	                continue
284	            if g == 2 and value.isalpha() and value[0].isupper():
285	                continue  # "Instagram: Familiarity and ..." is a heading, not a handle
286	            if g == 3 and value.lower() in USERNAME_STOPWORDS:
287	                continue
288	            _add(ents, "USERNAME", m.start(g), m.end(g), text, 0.9)
289	
290	    if want("ID_NUM"):
291	        for m in ID_CUE_RE.finditer(text):
292	            _add(ents, "ID_NUM", m.start(1), m.end(1), text, 0.92)
293	        for m in ID_BARE_RE.finditer(text):
294	            tok = m.group()
295	            digits = re.sub(r"\D", "", tok)
296	            if len(digits) < ID_BARE_MIN_DIGITS or NOT_AN_ID_RE.fullmatch(tok):
297	                continue
298	            conf = 0.6
299	            if len(digits) >= 13 and _luhn_ok(digits):
300	                conf = 0.95  # card-like
301	            elif len(digits) >= 7:
302	                conf = 0.75
303	            _add(ents, "ID_NUM", m.start(), m.end(), text, conf)
304	
305	    if want("STREET_ADDRESS"):
306	        for m in STREET_ADDRESS_RE.finditer(text):
307	            _add(ents, "STREET_ADDRESS", m.start(), m.end(), text, 0.85)
308	
309	    if want("DATE"):
310	        for m in DATE_RE.finditer(text):
311	            _add(ents, "DATE", m.start(), m.end(), text, 0.8)
312	
313	    if want("NAME_STUDENT"):
314	        for m in NAME_CUE_RE.finditer(text):
315	            g = next(i for i in (1, 2, 3) if m.group(i))
316	            name = m.group(g)
317	            if name.split()[0] in NAME_STOPWORDS:
318	                continue
319	            _add(ents, "NAME_STUDENT", m.start(g), m.end(g), text, 0.7)
320	
321	    if want("NAME_RELATED"):
322	        for m in list(NAME_RELATED_RE.finditer(text)) + list(NAME_TITLE_RE.finditer(text)):
323	            if m.group(1).split()[0] in NAME_STOPWORDS:
324	                continue
325	            _add(ents, "NAME_RELATED", m.start(1), m.end(1), text, 0.7)
326	
327	    if want("SCHOOL"):
328	        for m in SCHOOL_RE.finditer(text):
329	            start = m.start()
330	            if m.group(1):
331	                # "At Lincoln Middle School": the sentence opener is not part of the name.
332	                words = list(re.finditer(r"\S+", m.group(1)))
333	                while words and words[0].group() in NAME_STOPWORDS:
334	                    words.pop(0)
335	                # "In High School you get more homework" names no school.
336	                if all(w.group() in SCHOOL_KIND_WORDS for w in words):
337	                    continue
338	                start = m.start(1) + words[0].start()
339	            _add(ents, "SCHOOL", start, m.end(), text, 0.75)
340	
341	    if want("LOCATION"):
342	        for m in LOCATION_RE.finditer(text):
343	            g = 1 if m.group(1) else 2
344	            if m.group(g).split()[0] in NAME_STOPWORDS:
345	                continue
346	            _add(ents, "LOCATION", m.start(g), m.end(g), text, 0.75)
347	
348	    if want("AGE"):
349	        for m in AGE_RE.finditer(text):
350	            g = next(i for i in (1, 2, 3, 4) if m.group(i))
351	            if int(m.group(g)) > 0:
352	                _add(ents, "AGE", m.start(g), m.end(g), text, 0.8)
353	
354	    if want("DATE"):
355	        for m in BIRTHDAY_RE.finditer(text):
356	            _add(ents, "DATE", m.start(1), m.end(1), text, 0.8)
357	
358	    if want("IP_ADDRESS"):
359	        for m in IPV4_RE.finditer(text):
360	            _add(ents, "IP_ADDRESS", m.start(), m.end(), text, 0.95)
361	        for m in IPV6_RE.finditer(text):
362	            _add(ents, "IP_ADDRESS", m.start(), m.end(), text, 0.9)
363	
364	    if want("DEVICE_ID"):
365	        for m in MAC_RE.finditer(text):
366	            _add(ents, "DEVICE_ID", m.start(), m.end(), text, 0.95)
367	        for m in UUID_RE.finditer(text):
368	            _add(ents, "DEVICE_ID", m.start(), m.end(), text, 0.95)
369	
370	    if want("GEO"):
371	        for m in GEO_RE.finditer(text):
372	            _add(ents, "GEO", m.start(), m.end(), text, 0.9)
373	
374	    return resolve_overlaps(ents)

377	def resolve_overlaps(ents: List[Entity]) -> List[Entity]:
378	    """Keep the higher-confidence, then longer, entity when spans overlap.
379	
380	    Model entities win ties against rule entities of the same length.
381	    """
382	    ordered = sorted(
383	        ents,
384	        key=lambda e: (-e.confidence, -(e.end - e.start), 0 if e.source == "model" else 1, e.start),
385	    )
386	    kept: List[Entity] = []
387	    for e in ordered:
388	        if not any(e.overlaps(k) for k in kept):
389	            kept.append(e)
390	    kept.sort(key=lambda e: e.start)
391	    return kept

394	def propagate_names(
395	    text: str, ents: List[Entity], min_token_len: int = 3, min_model_confidence: float = 0.75
396	) -> List[Entity]:
397	    """Tag every other occurrence of a detected name (full name and each
398	    capitalised name token) so a name caught once is caught everywhere.
399	    Student names are handled first, so a name that is both keeps that label.
400	
401	    A name the model was unsure of is still flagged where the model found it,
402	    but is not spread through the document: one weak guess ("Hood", in
403	    "Little Red Riding Hood") should not become six."""
404	    names = [
405	        e for e in ents
406	        if e.label in NAME_LABELS and (e.source != "model" or e.confidence >= min_model_confidence)
407	    ]
408	    if not names:
409	        return ents
410	    out = list(ents)
411	    seen = {(e.start, e.end) for e in ents}
412	    needles = {}  # text -> (label, confidence); the first label wins
413	    for e in sorted(names, key=lambda e: NAME_LABELS.index(e.label)):
414	        full = e.text.strip()
415	        needles.setdefault(full, (e.label, e.confidence))
416	        for tok in full.split():
417	            tok = tok.strip(".")
